title: Module blueprints validate before planning and scaffolds regenerate without overwriting drift
statement: Every module blueprint MUST validate against law/schemas/module-blueprint.schema.json and MUST be rejected when it declares no entity, an entity with an empty primary key, a PII field without explicit retention, or an API operation that no RBAC permission grants; the scaffold plan and every rendered scaffold file MUST be a deterministic function of the blueprint, its canonical sha256, and the template, and a scaffold target that already exists with different bytes MUST be reported as drift for review and never overwritten.
rationale: Article 17 requires contracts to validate and generated artifacts to regenerate to identical bytes; a blueprint is the architecture-class specification Article 6 names, so a scaffold that overwrites hand-edited output or derives from an invalid blueprint corrupts the plant silently.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
